_about: Overnight Oct 17, Part 10: every enemy and boss for the Bestiary (Bestiary). name = the enemy's battle name (BattleContext.enemy_name) or roamer display name; kind = roamer / foe / boss; where = where the hero meets it; icon = a game-icons path under assets/icons (a fallback is used when missing); blurb = one fun line. Hand-formatted: edit as text.

entries.name: Cave Scavenger
entries.blurb: Lives on whatever falls down the well. Has opinions about your boots.

entries.name: Hollow Stalker
entries.blurb: Moves without a sound. Breathes like a broken accordion, though.

entries.name: Hollow Warden
entries.blurb: An Old Kingdom guardian of moss and stone. Only lets royalty pass. Checks ID very slowly.

entries.name: The Wellspring's Echo
entries.blurb: The spring's memory of four Paths, poured into one shape. Tests every hand that reaches into the well. Politely. Then not.

entries.name: Pantry Hound
entries.blurb: Got into the Special Sauce and never quite got out. Will fetch. Will not give back.

entries.name: Lost Junior Clerk
entries.blurb: Wandered off the causeway with the wrong form. Would like directions, and your paperwork.

entries.name: Bin Raccoon
entries.blurb: Tin-can helmet, bin-lid shield. The bins are his. All of them. Ask anyone.

entries.name: Quota Spotter
entries.blurb: Spots you. Writes you up. Counts your reps for the Chancellor, and none of them count.

entries.name: Protein Shake Golem
entries.blurb: Vanilla flavour, chocolate attitude. Shake well before battle.

entries.name: Sprinting Energy Sprite
entries.blurb: Pre-workout given a body and no brakes. It does not want to fight. It wants to run THROUGH you.

entries.name: Shambling Middle Manager
entries.blurb: Dead for years, still schedules meetings. Wants to circle back about your soul.

entries.name: Unpaid Intern
entries.blurb: Unpaid in life, unpaid in death. Learning a lot, though. Cannot see over the forms.

entries.name: Speedy Ghost Courier
entries.blurb: Delivers in 30 minutes or your afterlife is free. Signature required. Yours.

entries.name: Meatloaf Golem
entries.blurb: Grandma's recipe, grandma's temper. Glazed for your protection.

entries.name: Gelatin Sentinel
entries.blurb: There is always room for it. That is the problem.

entries.name: Runaway Meatball
entries.blurb: Rolled off a plate and never looked back. Mostly sauce, entirely momentum.

entries.name: Colonel Casserole
entries.blurb: Layered, decorated and extremely full of himself. Serves eight.

entries.name: Mossy Trash Golem
entries.blurb: Somebody's old couch, three tyres and a dream. Mostly the dream now.

entries.name: Hungry Scarecrow
entries.blurb: Used to scare crows. Now it keeps growing, and the crows are worried about it.

entries.name: Junk Gull Flock
entries.blurb: They saw your chips. They will always have seen your chips.

entries.name: Correction Officer
entries.blurb: Has a clipboard for your clipboard. Smiles exactly on regulation. Corrects yours.

entries.name: Perfection Inspector
entries.blurb: Found a speck on the sun once. Filed a complaint. Still waiting.

entries.name: Tidy-Bot
entries.blurb: Thinks you are litter. Is not entirely wrong after a long day.

entries.name: Rift Wretch
entries.blurb: Crawled out of a crack in the world and immediately regretted it.

entries.name: Shard Swarm
entries.blurb: Pieces of something perfect that broke. Very sharp about it.

entries.name: Captain Spotless
entries.blurb: Guards the gate. Polishes the gate. Is, spiritually, the gate.

entries.name: Treadmill Sprinter
entries.blurb: Has run four thousand miles. Has never left this room.

entries.name: Courtyard Lifter
entries.blurb: Lifts the courtyard. Not in the courtyard. The courtyard.

entries.name: Vivienne Quota, Minister of Efficiency
entries.where: The House of Gains; later the Transit Yards
entries.blurb: Designed the wheels, the schedules and the Iron-less Prison. Has timed this sentence. You were slow.

entries.name: Cell Block Brawler
entries.blurb: Got locked up for flexing in a no-flex zone. Has not stopped since.

entries.name: Trophy Hall Honor Guard
entries.blurb: Guards a hall of participation trophies with deadly seriousness.

entries.name: Chancellor Clench, Iron Regent
entries.blurb: Seized the Gainlands mid-set. Still has not racked the bar.

entries.name: Prep Station Sous-Chef
entries.blurb: Dices onions, feelings and adventurers with equal precision.

entries.name: Frozen Line Cook
entries.blurb: Got locked in the walk-in during the rush. Came out cooler.

entries.name: Unfinished War Machine
entries.blurb: Half oven, half cannon, all under-baked.

entries.name: Assembly Line Golem
entries.blurb: Plates a thousand meals an hour. Tastes none of them. Sad, really.

entries.name: Cannon-Blender Gunner
entries.blurb: Fires smoothies at speeds the kitchen cannot legally serve.

entries.name: Expediter of the Pass
entries.blurb: Yells HANDS at you. You have hands. That is somehow worse.

entries.name: The Doppelganger
entries.blurb: Posing as Grand Chef Escoffina. The moustache is drawn on. In gravy.

entries.name: Intake Clerk
entries.blurb: Takes your number. Takes your name. Takes forever.

entries.name: Returns Clerk
entries.blurb: Nothing is ever returned. That is the whole joke of the department.

entries.name: Notary Wraith
entries.blurb: Witnesses signatures from beyond. Charges a fee from beyond, too.

entries.name: Resurrection Permits Zombie
entries.blurb: Got his permit approved. Still wondering if it was worth the queue.

entries.name: Undersecretary Vellum
entries.blurb: Paper-thin and twice as cutting. Speaks only in footnotes.

entries.name: Executive Elevator Operator
entries.blurb: Going up? Not without an appointment. Going down? Always.

entries.name: Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No
entries.blurb: Has said no to every request for three hundred years. Including yours, pre-emptively.

entries.name: Overgrown Scarecrow
entries.blurb: The crows won. It just has not been told.

entries.name: Mutant Mushroom Troop
entries.blurb: Fungi with ambition. Spores with a plan.

entries.name: Hortensia Clipwell, Royal Groundskeeper
entries.blurb: Outlawed compost, gave a grieving druid a seed that never dies, and trimmed the result into a hedge. Very tidy.

entries.name: Thorn Maze Stalker
entries.blurb: Knows every turn of the maze. Gets lost on purpose for fun.

entries.name: Hive of Mutant Bees
entries.blurb: Not the bees. Definitely the bees. Bigger bees.

entries.name: Rot Tunnel Horror
entries.blurb: Smells like a compost heap that has seen things.

entries.name: Compostella, the Rotheart
entries.blurb: The Refusemancers' leader, corrupted. Turned everything to mulch, even her manners.

entries.name: Hedge Trimmer Guard
entries.blurb: Trims hedges to the millimetre. Trims intruders to the same standard.

entries.name: Gallery Curator
entries.blurb: Every painting in the gallery is of Primm. He picked the frames.

entries.name: Mirror Knight
entries.blurb: Reflects your moves back at you. Also your fashion choices, unkindly.

entries.name: Ministry Clerk
entries.blurb: Stamps 'IMPROVED' on everything. Including the stamp.

entries.name: Royal Staircase Guard
entries.blurb: Guards the stairs. Has never climbed them. Too scared of the top.

entries.name: Coup Barracks Sergeant
entries.blurb: Was there the night the king fell. Has not slept well since.

entries.name: Seed Vault Gardener
entries.blurb: Grows the only symmetrical flowers in the kingdom. They hate it too.

entries.name: Clocktower Sentinel
entries.blurb: Keeps perfect time. Primm's time. It runs eleven minutes fast.

entries.name: Percival Plume, Deputy Minister of Good News
entries.blurb: Drafted the transfer, read every broadcast, cut every ribbon. Has never once been wrong, according to Percival Plume.

entries.name: Primm, His Perfection
entries.blurb: Former Minister of Improvements. Improved the king right off the throne. Sincerely thinks you are the problem.

entries.name: Calf Raise Crusher
entries.blurb: Calves like boulders. Personality like a boulder too.

entries.name: Squat Rack Squatter
entries.blurb: Has occupied the squat rack since the Old Kingdom. Is curling in it.

entries.name: Baron Quadzilla
entries.blurb: Never skipped leg day. Skipped every other day, though.

entries.name: Rival Lifter at Base Camp
entries.blurb: Says he can lift more than you. Says it every four seconds.

entries.name: Squat Rack Sentinel
entries.blurb: Spotting duty, eternal edition. Never once said 'all you'.

entries.name: The Ancient Spotter
entries.blurb: A stone colossus who has spotted the same barbell for a thousand years. 'Two more reps.'

entries.name: Apprentice Itamae
entries.blurb: Has been washing rice for nine years. Allowed to touch fish next spring.

entries.name: Conveyor Belt Sushi Chef
entries.blurb: Never stops. Never looks up. Plates arrive whether you ordered or not.

entries.name: The Itamae Supreme
entries.blurb: Master of the blade and his masterpiece. Omakase means you get what he serves. You get hurt.

entries.name: Receptionist of Number One
entries.blurb: Calls number one. Has been calling number one since before numbers.

entries.name: The Eternal Queue
entries.blurb: Not a person. A line. A line that fights. You are at the back.

entries.name: Betty Bones, Surly Secretary
entries.blurb: Runs the whole department from one chair. You may not sit in the chair.

entries.name: Alley Gate Raccoon
entries.blurb: Collects a toll in crusts. Rates them out of ten. Out loud.

entries.name: Pizza Crust Courtier
entries.blurb: Serves the court with a crust on a pillow. Very formal. Very greasy.

entries.name: His Majesty the Raccoon
entries.blurb: Wears a bottle-cap crown and sweats profusely. Rules by dumpster right.

entries.name: Sewer Checkpoint Enforcer
entries.blurb: Checks papers in the sewer. Everyone's papers are wet.

entries.name: Junction Patrol
entries.blurb: Patrols the junction. Left, right, left. Has never chosen right.

entries.name: Enforcer Captain Spotless
entries.blurb: His boots are clean down here. Nobody knows how. Nobody dares ask.

entries.name: Ration Line Supervisor
entries.blurb: Times every scoop. One scoop each. A second scoop is an act of rebellion, and also impossible.

entries.name: Vat Floor Golem
entries.blurb: Built to guard pantries, rebuilt to stir paste. It still salutes anything that smells of bread.

entries.name: Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense
entries.where: The Test Kitchen; later the Paste Works
entries.blurb: Ordered the swap, built the war machines, invented the paste. Has never once tasted anything on purpose.

entries.name: Decontamination Technician
entries.blurb: Sprays you with something. Says it is for your own good. Will not say what it is.

entries.name: Escaped Specimen
entries.blurb: Got out of its jar. Wants to get back in. Too big now.

entries.name: The Failed Experiment
entries.blurb: Every Path at once, none of them well. Proof of why it was a bad idea.

entries.name: Hybrid Specimen
entries.blurb: Three Paths in one body, none of them asked. It is labelled, dated and very, very cross.

entries.name: Antechamber Sentry
entries.blurb: Guards the last door before the Theater. Has been told the door is for your own good.

entries.name: The Drain Warden
entries.blurb: Kept the draining chamber running for ten years. Knows your face. You remember his.

entries.name: Siphon's Research Assistant
entries.blurb: Unpaid, overworked and very sorry about everything. Fights anyway.

entries.name: Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist
entries.blurb: Drained a prince for a decade and called it research. The prince would like a word.

entries.name: Rusty Gate Clockwork
entries.blurb: Opens the gate. Very slowly. Mostly it squeaks.

entries.name: Banner Hall Guardian
entries.blurb: Guards the old banners. Dusts them every century, whether they need it or not.

entries.name: The Old Kingdom Automaton
entries.blurb: Built to guard the vault forever. Forever is going fine, thanks.

entries.name: Shiro Swindle
entries.blurb: The Master of the Oldest Trick. Hides in chests that are too good to be true. They always are.

entries.name: The Restless Dead
entries.blurb: Everybody in the graveyard, all at once, very annoyed about the noise.

entries.name: Corrupted Wanderers
entries.blurb: Brick, Fennel, Moss and Prudence, each bent by their own Path. Beat them and they remember who they were.

entries.name: The Warden of the Four Seals
entries.blurb: Pull all four levers and it wakes up. Pull them wrong and it wakes up angrier.
